message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. In most cases, the complaint is handled by the **Atlanta Police Department** or the **City’s Office of Noise Control**. Here’s how you can do it:

| Method | How to File | Contact Info |
|--------|-------------|--------------|
| **Online** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> and select “Noise Complaint.” You’ll be prompted to fill out a form with details such as location, time, and description of the noise. | N/A |
| **Phone** | Call the 311 hotline (or the Atlanta Police Department) at **404‑656‑4000**. Tell the operator you’d like to file a noise complaint; they will guide you through the process. | 404‑656‑4000 |
| **Email** | Send an email to the Office of Noise Control: **noisecontrol@atlantaga.gov**. Include your name, contact information, the address of the noisy property, and a brief description of the issue. | noisecontrol@atlantaga.gov |
| **In‑person** | Visit the City Hall at **100 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30303**. Go to the City Clerk’s office or the Office of Noise Control to submit a written complaint. | 100 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

### What to Include in Your Complaint
- **Your contact information** (name, phone number, email).
- **Exact address or intersection** of the noisy property.
- **Time(s)** when the noise occurs (e.g., “late night, 11 pm–2 am”).
- **Description of the noise** (construction, loud music, barking dogs, etc.).
- **Any prior attempts** to resolve the issue (e.g., talking to the neighbor).

### After Filing
- The police or noise control office will investigate and may issue a warning or citation if the noise violates city ordinances.
- If the problem persists, you can follow up by calling 404‑656‑4000 or emailing noisecontrol@atlantaga.gov.

Feel free to let me know if you need help drafting the email or filling out the online form!
